DRIVER STATION

Take the field.

Drag the field to orbit the camera; scroll to zoom. Select Follow robot for a close driving view. Click the field, then use WASD / arrow keys to move. Swerve movement is field-relative; tank uses W/S for forward/reverse and A/D to turn.

Q / E rotates your chassis. The green edge is your intake: approach fuel head-on. I toggles intake. Hold Space to fire at your alliance hub. Auto-aim controls a virtual turret; disable it to shoot along your chassis heading.

P pauses. Change rates and dimensions in the workshop at any time. Saving stores one custom profile in this browser.

This is a simplified practice model: approximate field structures, circular robot collision envelope, ballistic fuel, and statistical shot spread. Team presets are illustrative, not scouting data. No official match scoring, climbing, or multiplayer.
